content: पुष्पित {%a.%} .²1 Flowered, full of flowers, in bloom, blooming; चिरविरहेण विलोक्य पुष्पिताग्राम् <ls>Gīt. 4</ls> (where पुष्पिताग्रा is also the name of a metre). .²2 Florid, flowery (as speech). .²3 A bounding or rich in; as in सुवर्णपुष्पितां पृथ्वीम् <ls>Pt. 1. 45</ls>. .²4 Fully developed, completely manifested. .²5 Spotted, variegated. .{@-ता@} A woman in her courses.
